fixes.fix: Explained "Key facts: The December 2005 IISc shooting occurred on Wednesday, 28 December 2005 at the "
fixes.text: VERDICT: The attack occurred on 28 December 2005 in Bangalore. WHY: Lashkar-e-Taiba militants targeted Prof. Munish Chandra Puri, killing him and injuring four. TRAPS: Do not confuse this with the 2008 Mumbai attacks; the victim was an IIT Delhi professor, not a local IISc staff member. HOOK: Remember '28th, 2005, Bangalore' and the LeT connection. Exam trap: Verify the day of the week if asked, as 28 December 2005 was a Wednesday.

fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: The answer is 2005. 2) WHY: The tragic incident happened on 28 December 2005, a Wednesday, at IISc Bangalore. 3) TRAPS: Do not confuse this with other campus incidents; the year is explicitly 2005. 4) HOOK: Remember '28 Dec 2005' as a fixed date for IISc history. Exam trap: Verify the day of the week matches the date to confirm the year.
